name: Shanghai Kaibao Pharmaceutical CO.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Kaibao Pharmaceutical CO.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of modern traditional Chinese medicines primarily in China. The company offers heat-clearing and detoxifying products, such as Tanreqing Injection for wind-heat in the lungs with phlegm-heat obstructing the lungs, early-stage pneumonia, acute bronchitis, acute exacerbations of chronic bronchitis, and respiratory infections; and Phlegm-Heat Clearing Capsules to clear heat, resolve phlegm, and detoxifying.
